question: KX 3 is related to OV -9 in a certain way. In the same way, IR 11 is related to MP -1. Το which of the given options is JG -2 related, following the same logic?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**KX 3 : OV -9**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5076b22f667ecf4ff85c312dc4d77575474c6f9a6407fd2a1a0b5fc4ca3b8a53.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c77f9e38b316e35140910d3999246f7febaa0db9f8bd1e00b091c330e24e13f9.png] 

**Applying the same logic to JG -2:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65cc56eebe49d774ebf3de4b326c4fb250487b30d9cd3f9e2bc589bb6911653a.png]
